source.description: One reviewed six-panel felt-tip marker contact sheet cropped into five cumulative process frames and one finished master.
source.notes: Keep one face-free red boxing glove punching toward the upper right with one curled thumb, one wide cuff, one cuff patch without text, curved seams, exactly three short motion dashes, thick black outlines, visible marker grain, and one broken shadow. No fist impact burst, words, letters, numbers, logo, badge, or sticker border.

process_strategy: Reserve the glove, thumb, cuff, wordless patch, seam, three motion dashes, and shadow in pale construction before drawing the outside contour; clarify the same landmarks before the heavy felt-tip and color passes; limit the final panel to selected outline, fill, highlight, and shadow cleanup.

final_elements.name: pale glove thumb cuff patch seam motion and shadow construction
final_elements.description: A tilted mitten-and-cuff envelope with reserved thumb, wordless cuff patch, curved seam, exactly three motion dashes, and broken shadow footprints.

final_elements.name: rounded boxing glove curled thumb and wide cuff silhouette
final_elements.description: One puffy face-free boxing glove angled toward the upper right with a rounded knuckle mass, curled thumb, narrow wrist, and wide cuff.

final_elements.name: curved palm seam knuckle creases cuff patch and three motion dashes
final_elements.description: One curved palm seam, three short knuckle creases, one blank cuff patch, and exactly three short motion dashes placed behind the glove.

final_elements.name: thick black felt-tip outline and broken cast shadow
final_elements.description: Handmade black marker reinforces all established glove, thumb, cuff, patch, seam, crease, motion, and shadow boundaries.

final_elements.name: tomato-red burgundy mustard and navy marker fills
final_elements.description: Tomato red fills the glove, burgundy deepens the thumb and seams, mustard fills the blank cuff patch and motion dashes, and navy anchors the broken shadow with visible marker grain.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The palm seam stops at the curled thumb, the wrist edges stop at the cuff, and all three motion dashes stay outside the glove silhouette instead of crossing through it.

rejection_checks: Keep one face-free boxing glove, one upper-right punch angle, one crop, and one scale in all six panels.
The rounded knuckles, curled thumb, wrist, cuff, blank patch, palm seam, three knuckle creases, three motion dashes, and shadow must stay in the same positions after they appear.
Do not draw the palm seam through the thumb, the wrist through the cuff, or any motion dash through the glove silhouette.
Do not add a face, second glove, hand, arm, punching bag, impact burst, words, letters, numbers, logo, badge frame, or sticker outline.
The final panel may not introduce a new seam, crease, patch, motion mark, shadow shape, or color area.
The finish must retain visible felt-tip grain and imperfect handmade edges rather than vector-clean sports clip art, a glossy logo, or polished AI poster art.
